rawFindings.title: Use of preparePopulationOptions ensures lean option passes to population
rawFindings.explanation: Replaced direct call to utils.object.vals with preparePopulationOptions, which sets 'lean' on all populate options when querying with lean option. This fix prevents the lean setting from being ignored during population.
rawFindings.suggestion: No change needed; this fixes a missing lean option propagation bug during population.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: Using lean query with population correctly sets the lean option for population queries and returns plain JS objects as expected instead of hydrated documents.

rawFindings.title: Definition of preparePopulationOptions and makeLean functions for population
rawFindings.explanation: Added functions preparePopulationOptions and makeLean to prepare population options and set the lean option on each population path. This fixes the missing propagation of lean to populate options allowing population to respect the lean setting on the query.
rawFindings.suggestion: No change needed; this addition corrects lean option handling during population.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: Population queries with lean option now behave correctly, returning plain objects rather than mongoose documents if lean is true.

rawFindings.title: Tests added to verify populated documents do not have update method when lean
rawFindings.explanation: New assertions verify that after population, populated documents do not have an 'update' method defined when lean option is set on query, thus ensuring lean option properly causes populated docs to be plain JS objects without Mongoose document methods.
rawFindings.suggestion: No immediate fix needed; tests are added for verification only.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: Populated documents are verified to be plain objects without Mongoose document methods as expected when lean is true.
